                        $this nltl:bladeExpandedAreaRatio ?earNode ;

Required change: Do not produce a violation solely because a positive-shear position is in the unspecified 0.6-to-0.9 LUI interval; enforce the Cf boundary values only within their explicitly specified intervals, while retaining FI = Cf × FIB for positive-shear cases. | [CONTROLLED_VOCABULARY] I2-051-ShipShape/nltl:hasCalculationCase/[nltl:shearForceDirection]: The direction value is constrained only by cardinality, so an arbitrary resource or literal can be supplied; the SPARQL formula is then skipped unless the value happens to equal nltl:positiveShearForce, allowing an invalid direction value to bypass the positive-shear applicability condition. Required change: Constrain nltl:shearForceDirection values to the canonical shearForceDirectionValue class, while retaining the conditional formula enforcement only for nltl:positiveShearForce.

sh:sparql [ sh:message Literal("Spindle torque factor and torque results must satisfy the declared blade-failure formula.") ; sh:select Literal("
                    PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
                    PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
                    SELECT $this
                    WHERE {
                        $this nltl:bladeExpandedAreaRatio ?earNode ;
                              nltl:propellerBladeCount ?z ;
                              nltl:leadingEdgeChordPortionAtZeroPointEightRadius ?leNode ;
                              nltl:trailingEdgeChordPortionAtZeroPointEightRadius ?teNode ;
                              nltl:extremeIceForce ?forceNode ;
                              nltl:bladeFailureSpindleTorqueFactor ?factorNode ;
                              nltl:bladeFailureSpindleTorque ?failureNode ;
                              nltl:maximumSpindleTorque ?maximumNode .
                        ?earNode qudt:numericValue ?ear .
                        ?leNode qudt:numericValue ?le .
                        ?teNode qudt:numericValue ?te .
                        ?forceNode qudt:numericValue ?force .
                        ?factorNode qudt:numericValue ?factor .
                        ?failureNode qudt:numericValue ?failure .
                        ?maximumNode qudt:numericValue ?maximum .
                        BIND((4.0 * ?ear) / xsd:decimal(?z) AS ?ratio)
                        BIND(0.7 * (1.0 - (?ratio * ?ratio * ?ratio)) AS ?rawFactor)
                        BIND(IF(?rawFactor < 0.3, 0.3, ?rawFactor) AS ?expectedFactor)
                        BIND(IF(?le > (0.8 * ?te), ?le, (0.8 * ?te)) AS ?chord)
                        BIND(?chord * ?expectedFactor * ?force AS ?expectedTorque)
                        BIND((ABS(?expectedFactor) * 0.000001) + 0.000000001 AS ?factorTolerance)
                        BIND((ABS(?expectedTorque) * 0.000001) + 0.000000001 AS ?torqueTolerance)
                        FILTER(
                            ABS(?factor - ?expectedFactor) > ?factorTolerance ||
                            ABS(?failure - ?expectedTorque) > ?torqueTolerance ||
                            ABS(?maximum - ?expectedTorque) > ?torqueTolerance
                        )
                    }
                ") ] ]"]
